source.stem:
Multiple choice question: Which of the following statements about gymnosperms and angiosperms is correct ( )
A. The seeds of gymnosperms are covered with pericarp.
B. The seeds of angiosperms are exposed
C. Gymnosperm seeds are exposed
D. The cones of gymnosperms are fruits

options.text: The seeds of gymnosperms are covered by a pericarp
The seeds of angiosperms are exposed
The cones of gymnosperms are fruits

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Different regions always have different plants and animals, even if their conditions are the same.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Deserts have little water because desert plants and animals live there.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: No kind of plant or animal can live in both a desert and a mountain because their conditions differ.

intelligence.enrichment: Plants and animals found in one kind of region are different from those found in another kind of region because the conditions in regions differ, such as little water and extreme temperatures in deserts or frequent snowfall in extremely cold mountains. regional_conditions -> different_regional_biodiversity The learner correctly applies this rule: Plants and animals found in one kind of region are different from those found in another kind of region because the conditions in regions differ, such as little water and extreme temperatures in deserts or frequent snowfall in extremely cold mountains. Plants and animals are different in each place just by chance; water, temperature, snowfall, and other regional conditions do not shape which organisms can live there.
